info.title: Xtab API
info.description: REST API of Xtab: workspaces, bases, tables, fields, views, records, imports and exports, members and their roles.

servers.description: Relative to the address of the installation

post.summary:
Log in: a session cookie `__Host-xtab_session`. Every failure — wrong password, unknown
or inactive account — gets the same answer in the same time. An account with a second
factor gets no session yet: `202` with the token of the waiting login.

200.description: Logged in; the session cookie is set

202.description: The password is right; the second factor follows by `POST /auth/login/second-factor`

post.summary: End the session; the browser drops its cache and storage (`Clear-Site-Data`).

204.description: Logged out; the cookie is removed

post.summary:
Confirm the person of the session again with the password: for
ten minutes the session may do what needs it, e.g. export more than 1000 records. A wrong
password keeps the session; attempts count in the limits of login.

422.description: validation-failed: wrong-password

post.summary: Set the first password of an invited account and log in.

422.description: validation-failed: token-invalid or a rule of the password

post.summary:
Request a letter with a reset link. Always `202`, at once: whether the account exists
is not revealed.

202.description: Accepted; a letter is sent if the account may get one

post.summary: Set a new password; every session of the account is revoked.

422.description: validation-failed: token-invalid or a rule of the password

get.summary: The account of the session.

patch.summary:
Change the settings of one's own account: the language of the interface, the name, the
time zone of dates. What is absent stays; `null` clears the language or the time zone.

422.description: validation-failed: a language the interface does not speak, an empty or too long name, an unknown time zone

post.summary: Change one's own password with the current one: the other sessions of the account end.

422.description: validation-failed: the current password is wrong, or the new one is too short, too long, the e-mail or breached

post.summary:
The second factor of a waiting login: a code of the authenticator app or a recovery code.
A right one sets the session cookie; five wrong ones end the waiting login.

200.description: Logged in; the session cookie is set

422.description: validation-failed: code-invalid, or token-invalid — the waiting login is over, log in again

get.summary: The protection of one's own account: the second factor, the recovery codes left.

post.summary:
Start the second factor by an authenticator app, with the password confirmed a moment
before: a new secret to add to the app. It guards the login once a first code confirms it.

409.description: totp-enabled: turn the second factor off first

delete.summary:
Turn the second factor off, with the password confirmed a moment before; the recovery
codes go with it.

post.summary:
Confirm the new secret by a code of the app: the second factor is on. The answer has ten
recovery codes, shown once.

422.description: validation-failed: code-invalid

post.summary:
New recovery codes, with the password confirmed a moment before; the old ones stop
working.

200.description: The new recovery codes, shown once

422.description: validation-failed: the second factor is off

post.summary:
Start a login by a passkey: the options for the browser, which offers the passkeys it has
for this address. The chosen passkey names the account; no e-mail is asked.

200.description: The options and the token of the ceremony

409.description: passkeys-not-configured: the public address of the installation is not a domain

post.summary:
Log in by a passkey: the answer of the browser to the options. The device checks its
owner, so neither the password nor the code of the app is asked; every failure gets the
same answer.

200.description: Logged in; the session cookie is set

422.description: validation-failed: token-invalid — the ceremony is over, start again

get.summary: The passkeys of one's own account, oldest first.

post.summary: Add the passkey the browser made, under a name.

422.description: validation-failed: name; credential — not made for this ceremony, or added already; token-invalid — the ceremony is over

post.summary:
Start a new passkey of one's own account, with the password confirmed a moment before: the
options for the browser, which makes the passkey on the device or in a password manager.

200.description: The options and the token of the ceremony

409.description: passkeys-not-configured: the public address of the installation is not a domain

delete.summary: Remove a passkey of one's own account, with the password confirmed a moment before.

post.summary:
Start a confirmation of the person by one of their passkeys, in place of the password: the
options for the browser, which offers only the passkeys of this account.

200.description: The options and the token of the ceremony

409.description: passkeys-not-configured: the public address of the installation is not a domain

422.description: validation-failed: passkey — the account has none

post.summary:
Confirm the person by the answer of the browser to the options, as the password does: for
a few minutes the session may do what needs a confirmation.

422.description: validation-failed: credential — the answer failed its check; token-invalid — the ceremony is over, start again

delete.summary:
Remove every second factor of another account of the organization — the authenticator
app, the recovery codes, the passkeys — and close its sessions (administrator, with the
password confirmed a moment before). The person gets a letter and sets the factor up
again after a login with the password.

204.description: Reset; the sessions of the account are closed

403.description: forbidden: not an administrator; step-up-required: confirm the password

422.description: validation-failed: user — one's own account, whose factors are turned off in the profile

get.summary:
The active sessions of one's own account, the latest active first; `current` marks the
session of this request.

delete.summary: End a session of one's own account on every node; ending the current one is a logout.

404.description: not-found: no such active session of the account

post.summary:
End every session of one's own account but the current one, with the password confirmed
a moment before.

Log in with a new password when the current one expired: the same answers as
`POST /auth/login` once the new password passes the policy.

200.description: Logged in with the new password; the session cookie is set

202.description: The new password is set; the second factor follows by `POST /auth/login/second-factor`

422.description: validation-failed: the new password does not pass the policy, or the password did not expire (new_password)

get.summary: Passwords and the lockout.

403.description: forbidden: not an administrator; step-up-required: confirm the password to ask for less

422.description: validation-failed: a value out of its bounds

post.summary:
Unlock an account locked by failed logins (administrator); an account not locked stays as
it is.

patch.summary:
Change an account (administrator): block or unblock it, give or take the flag of an
administrator. Giving the flag needs the password confirmed a moment before. A blocked
person's sessions end at once and their tokens stop; one's own account is changed by
another administrator.

403.description: forbidden: not an administrator; step-up-required: confirm the password to give the flag

422.description: validation-failed: user — one's own account; status — not `active` or `blocked`, or the account is invited

post.summary:
End every session and revoke every token of an account (administrator): a stolen device
or a leaked token stops at once on every node.

422.description: validation-failed: user — one's own account, whose sessions are ended in the profile

get.summary:
Who holds what (administrator): the workspaces and bases of the organization with the
roles of people and groups, without their data.

200.description: The workspaces with their bases and roles

post.summary:
Give oneself a role in a workspace or a base (administrator), to see its data: the
password is confirmed a moment before, the audit keeps it and the owners of the place get
a letter. The flag of an administrator alone gives no access to data.

403.description: forbidden: not an administrator; step-up-required: confirm the password

409.description: last-owner: one's own last role of an owner is not lowered here

422.description: validation-failed: an unknown role

post.summary:
Make an active person the owner of a workspace or a base whose owner left
(administrator), with the password confirmed a moment before.

403.description: forbidden: not an administrator; step-up-required: confirm the password

422.description: validation-failed: user — not an active person of the organization

post.summary:
Delete an account on the request of the person (administrator): its data is exported to
an archive — the link goes to the person, the administrator downloads it here — and the
account is anonymized: no name, no e-mail, no way to log in, its e-mail free again. Its
values in tables and the audit keep it as «Deleted user No. N». The sessions end and the
tokens stop at once; the rest takes the worker a few seconds. The e-mail of the account,
typed again, and the password confirmed a moment before confirm it.

202.description: Accepted: the export and the deletion are on their way

403.description: forbidden: not an administrator; step-up-required: confirm the password first

409.description: conflict: the account is being exported already

422.description: validation-failed: user — one's own account, or deleted already; email — not the e-mail of the account

get.summary:
The latest exports of the data of accounts in the organization (administrator), newest
first: by the people themselves and before deletions.

The archive of an export (administrator), within its day: the download is an event of
the audit.

200.description: The ZIP archive with JSON files

404.description: not-found: no such export, not finished, or its day is over

503.description: dependency-unavailable: the storage of files does not answer

get.summary: The latest export of one's own data.

post.summary:
Ask for an export of one's own data: a ZIP archive of JSON files — the profile, the
groups and roles, the sessions, the API tokens without their values and the events of the
audit about oneself. It is ready in a few seconds and lives a day; a letter with a link
to it goes to one's e-mail. The password confirmed a moment before confirms it.

202.description: Accepted: the export is on its way

409.description: conflict: an export is on its way already

get.summary: The archive of the latest export of one's own data, within its day.

200.description: The ZIP archive with JSON files

404.description: not-found: none ready, or its day is over

503.description: dependency-unavailable: the storage of files does not answer

post.summary:
The archive of the data of an account by the link of its letter, within its day: no
session is needed — the account may be deleted already. The token goes in the body, so
it never reaches the logs of addresses.

200.description: The ZIP archive with JSON files

404.description: not-found: no such link, or its day is over

503.description: dependency-unavailable: the storage of files does not answer

get.summary: Events of the audit, newest first (administrator; a token with `audit:read`).

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: One action, `login.failed`, or every action of an area, `login.`.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The cursor of the page: `next` of the previous one.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Events of the page, 1–500, 50 by default.

400.description: malformed-request: a parameter or a cursor that does not read

422.description: validation-failed: an unknown action, a moment that is not one, a limit out of range

get.summary:
The sealed events after a number of seal, oldest first: for a SIEM that takes the events
itself (administrator; a token with `audit:read`).

parameters.name: after
parameters.description:
The events after this number of seal; 0 — from the start of the chain in the
database.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Events of the page, 1–500, 500 by default.

422.description: validation-failed: a number or a limit out of range

get.summary:
The events of the filter as CSV, newest first, at most 100 000 (administrator, the
password confirmed a moment before). The download is an event of the audit itself.

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: One action, `login.failed`, or every action of an area, `login.`.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The cursor of the page: `next` of the previous one.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Events of the page, 1–500, 50 by default.

403.description: forbidden: not an administrator; step-up-required: confirm the password

422.description: validation-failed: an unknown action, a moment that is not one

get.summary:
The state of the audit: the chain, its last checkpoint and check, the archived months
(administrator).
The period of the audit and the thresholds of the alerts (administrator).

put.summary:
Change the period of the audit or the thresholds of the alerts (administrator, the
password confirmed a moment before). A threshold 0 turns its alert off.

403.description: forbidden: not an administrator; step-up-required: confirm the password

422.description: validation-failed: a period out of range

get.summary: The receivers of SIEM (administrator).

post.summary:
Add a receiver of SIEM (administrator, the password confirmed a moment before): it gets
the events sealed from now on.

403.description: forbidden: not an administrator; step-up-required: confirm the password

422.description: validation-failed: a name, host, port or format that does not fit; too many receivers

delete.summary: Remove a receiver of SIEM (administrator, the password confirmed a moment before).

403.description: forbidden: not an administrator; step-up-required: confirm the password

patch.summary: Change a receiver of SIEM (administrator, the password confirmed a moment before).

403.description: forbidden: not an administrator; step-up-required: confirm the password

422.description: validation-failed: a name, host, port or format that does not fit

get.summary: The built-in alerts of security, newest first (administrator).

parameters.name: open
parameters.description: `true` — only the alerts not handled yet.

parameters.name: before
parameters.description: The page after this alert, `alr_…`: the last one of the previous page.

post.summary: Mark an alert handled (administrator).

204.description: Handled; one handled before stays as it was

get.summary: The providers of the login page.

Start a login through a provider: the browser goes to the provider, the state of the
login goes into the cookie `__Host-oidc` for 10 minutes.

parameters.name: purpose
parameters.description:
`login` (by default), `link` — bind the account of the session, `step_up` — confirm an
action of the session.

parameters.name: return
parameters.description: The path inside the application to return to, `/` by default.

parameters.name: silent
parameters.description: `true` — a silent login (`prompt=none`) after the end of a session.

303.description: To the provider; on a failure to the login page with `?sso=<code>`

get.summary:
The return from a provider: a session, a binding or a confirmation, then the path the
login started for.

303.description: To the path of the login with the session cookie; on a failure to the login page or the profile with `?sso=<code>`

post.summary:
The back-channel logout of a provider (OpenID Connect Back-Channel Logout 1.0): its
signed logout token ends the sessions it opened for the session or the person it names.

400.description: invalid_request: no token, or no provider verifies it

get.summary: The identity providers of the organization (administrator).

post.summary: Add an identity provider (administrator, the password confirmed a moment before).

403.description: forbidden: not an administrator; step-up-required: confirm the password

409.description: provider-exists: the organization has this issuer and client

422.description: validation-failed: a field that does not fit

delete.summary:
Remove an identity provider with the bindings of accounts to it (administrator, the
password confirmed a moment before). Its sessions last until their end.

403.description: forbidden: not an administrator; step-up-required: confirm the password

patch.summary: Change an identity provider (administrator, the password confirmed a moment before).

403.description: forbidden: not an administrator; step-up-required: confirm the password

409.description: provider-exists: another provider has this issuer and client

422.description: validation-failed: a field that does not fit

post.summary: Check a provider: its discovery document and keys read now by this node (administrator).

get.summary:
The groups of the organization and the groups of the providers they follow
(administrator).

put.summary:
Set the group of the providers a group follows: its members are then set at every login
through a provider (administrator, the password confirmed a moment before).

403.description: forbidden: not an administrator; step-up-required: confirm the password

409.description: idp-group-taken: another group follows it

422.description: validation-failed: a name too long

get.summary: The lifetime of the sessions opened through a provider (administrator).

put.summary:
Change the lifetime of the sessions opened through a provider (administrator, the
password confirmed a moment before); the sessions open keep theirs.

403.description: forbidden: not an administrator; step-up-required: confirm the password

422.description: validation-failed: hours out of 1–24

get.summary: The providers of the organization and whether one's own account is bound to each.

delete.summary:
Unbind one's own account from a provider (the person confirmed a moment before). The
last way to log in stays: an account without a password keeps its last provider.

409.description: last-login-method: the account has no password and no other provider

post.summary:
Ask to change one's own e-mail: the password confirms it; a letter with a link goes to the
new address and a notice to the old one. The address changes when the link is opened.

202.description: Asked: the letter is on its way

409.description: mail-not-configured: letters are off in this installation

422.description: validation-failed: not an e-mail, the current one, taken, or a wrong password

post.summary: Confirm a new e-mail by the token of the link of its letter.

204.description: The e-mail of the account is the new one

422.description: validation-failed: token-invalid, or the address was taken meanwhile
validation-failed: not an avatar uploaded by this account

delete.summary: Take the avatar of one's own account away.

get.summary:
The matrix of rights of this version, generated from the code: the rights this build
enforces, without the ones still planned; readable by everyone who is logged in — the
rules of access are not a secret. The texts are in the language of the user.

The license of the installation: its state and the days left, for everyone who is logged
in — the interface warns before changes stop; to whom it is issued and why an installed
file is not used — for administrators of the organization.

The state of the installation: its license, backups, background migrations and what needs
attention.

403.description: forbidden: not an administrator of the instance with a second factor

put.summary:
Installs a license file of the vendor for every node, with the password confirmed. It works
when the installation reads only: this is the way out of that state.

204.description: Installed; the nodes apply it within five minutes

403.description: forbidden: not an administrator of the instance with a second factor; step-up-required: confirm the password

422.description: license-malformed or license-not-trusted: not a license of the vendor

get.summary:
The operational settings of the installation: the value in force of each and where it comes
from. Connections, keys and the limits of security are not among them.

403.description: forbidden: not an administrator of the instance with a second factor

put.summary:
Changes an operational setting for every node, with the password confirmed; `null` takes
the value of the panel away. The nodes apply it within seconds, without a restart.

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: The dotted key of the setting

403.description: forbidden: not an administrator of the instance with a second factor; step-up-required: confirm the password

409.description: setting-pinned: the configuration file fixes it

422.description: validation-failed: the value does not fit

get.summary: Workspaces the user has a role in, or a role in one of their bases, with those bases.

post.summary: Create a workspace; its creator becomes its owner. Any active user may.

422.description: validation-failed: the name

get.summary: A workspace with all its bases; needs a role in the workspace itself.

delete.summary: Delete a workspace with its bases (owner); the data stays until the trash removes it (v1).

422.description: validation-failed: the name

post.summary:
Create a base (creator of the workspace): `202` with the operation that creates its
schema; the base is in `object` of the operation once it succeeded.

422.description: validation-failed: the name

post.summary:
Copy a base with its tables, records, links, files, shared views and automations into
its workspace or another one (creator of the base and of the workspace of the copy): `202`
with the operation; the copy is in `object` of the operation once it succeeded. The data
are those of the moment the copy starts. The automations of the copy are disabled and
have no secrets; roles of the base are not copied.

404.description: not-found: the base or the workspace

422.description: validation-failed: the name

post.summary:
Copy a workspace with its bases (owner of the workspace): `202` with the operation; the
copy is in `object` of the operation once it succeeded, owned by the one who asked. The
bases are copied as by `POST /bases/{base}/copy`; roles of the workspace are not copied.

422.description: validation-failed: the name

get.summary: A base (reader of the base).

delete.summary: Delete a base (owner); the data stays until the trash removes it (v1).

422.description: validation-failed: the name

get.summary:
State of a structure operation; visible to whoever may open its base, or see its
workspace while the base is being created.

post.summary:
Create a table (creator of the base): `202` with the operation; the table is in
`object` of the operation once it succeeded. Without `fields` it gets «Название».

422.description: validation-failed: name, description or fields

get.summary: A table with its fields and shared views (reader of the base).

delete.summary:
Delete a table with its fields and views (creator of the base); the data stays until
the trash removes it (v1).

patch.summary:
Rename or describe a table, or choose the field that names its records (creator of the
base).

422.description: validation-failed: name taken or invalid, description too long, a primary field of another table or of a type that names no record

post.summary:
Copy a table in its base (creator of the base): its fields, records, links, files and
shared views as they are when the copy starts; `202` with the operation, the copy is in
`object` of the operation once it succeeded. A link to another table gets an inverse
field there named after the copy. Public links of forms and personal views are not
copied.

422.description: validation-failed: name

post.summary:
Add a field at the end of a table or before or after one of its fields (creator of the
base): `202` with the operation; the field is in `object` of the operation once it
succeeded.

422.description: validation-failed: name, type, description, options, before or after
validation-failed: the primary field

patch.summary:
Rename, describe or change the settings of a field (creator of the base). Choices of a
single or multiple select are the whole list: known ones by `id`, new ones without it.

202.description: Accepted: a new formula is checked and counted in the background; `Location` is the operation

422.description: validation-failed: name, description or options

post.summary:
What a change of the type of the field would do to its values: of the first 100 000
records, how many values would become empty, with up to 10 of them as the field shows
them now. Nothing changes.

409.description: field-converting: its type is changing already

422.description: validation-failed: type-not-allowed, unknown-type or the options

post.summary:
Change the type of the field: the values move to the new type in the background while the
field takes none, and values that do not fit become empty — the preview tells how many.
There is no way back. Its default and checks are not kept.

202.description: Accepted: the change starts; `Location` is the operation, and the field shows `converting` until the values have moved

409.description: field-converting: its type is changing already

422.description: validation-failed: type-not-allowed, unknown-type or the options

post.summary:
Create a shared view of a table (creator of the base); `grid` in v0.2. With `from`, the
new view copies the settings of that view of the same table.

422.description: validation-failed: name, type or from

get.summary: A shared view (reader of the base).

delete.summary: Delete a shared view (creator of the base); a table keeps at least one.

422.description: validation-failed: the last view of the table

patch.summary:
Rename a shared view or replace its settings (creator of the base): the order, widths and
visibility of the columns and the height of the rows.

422.description: validation-failed: the name or the settings

post.summary:
Invite a person. Without `workspace` and `base` — an administrator of the organization
only; with one of them — whoever manages its members, with a role by the rules of
granting. An active member is not invited again: give a role with `…/grants`.

201.description: Invited; the link went by mail (see `delivery`)

403.description: forbidden: not an administrator, or the role is above what the inviter may give

409.description: already-member

422.description: validation-failed: email, name, role

get.summary: The automations of a base, by name (creator of the base).

403.description: forbidden: not a creator of the base

post.summary:
Create an automation of a table of the base (creator of the base). It starts disabled;
the person who creates it is its owner, and its runs act with that person's rights.

403.description: forbidden: not a creator of the base

422.description: validation-failed: the name, the trigger, the condition, a step or a value; or too many automations

get.summary: An automation (creator of its base).

403.description: forbidden: not a creator of the base

delete.summary: Delete an automation with its versions (creator of its base).

403.description: forbidden: not a creator of the base

patch.summary:
Change the name, the description or the definition of an automation (creator of its
base). A new definition is a new version: runs already started finish by the version they
took. Its owner does not change.

403.description: forbidden: not a creator of the base

422.description: validation-failed: the name, the trigger, the condition, a step or a value

post.summary:
Enable an automation: it runs on its trigger from now on (creator of its base). An
automation the system stopped is enabled again the same way.

403.description: forbidden: not a creator of the base

post.summary: Disable an automation: it no longer starts runs (creator of its base).

403.description: forbidden: not a creator of the base

get.summary:
The runs of an automation, newest first, by pages of 50 (creator of its base). The log
keeps runs for the period of the organization, 30 days by default.

parameters.name: before
parameters.description: The page after this run, `run_…`: the last run of the previous page.

200.description: The runs; fewer than 50 — the last page

403.description: forbidden: not a creator of the base

get.summary: A run with its steps: what each read and wrote, and why it failed (creator of the base).

403.description: forbidden: not a creator of the base

post.summary:
Run a failed run, or one of unknown outcome, again (creator of the base): by the same
version, from the step that failed or whose outcome is unknown — the steps done stay
done. A step of unknown outcome is safe to repeat when its receiver keeps the
`Idempotency-Key` or the `Message-ID` the run sends.

403.description: forbidden: not a creator of the base

409.description: not-failed: only a failed run or one of unknown outcome runs again

post.summary:
Mark the step of unknown outcome of a run done (creator of the base): the letter or the
request had its effect, so the run goes on from the next step without repeating it.

403.description: forbidden: not a creator of the base

409.description: not-unknown: only a run of unknown outcome is marked done

get.summary: The secrets of an automation by name, without values (creator of its base).

403.description: forbidden: not a creator of the base

put.summary:
Set or replace the value of a secret of an automation (creator of its base). The value
is encrypted with the key of the organization and never shown again.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The name of the secret: Latin letters, digits, `_` and `-`, up to 64

403.description: forbidden: not a creator of the base

422.description: validation-failed: a name or a value that does not fit, too many secrets

delete.summary: Delete a secret of an automation (creator of its base).

403.description: forbidden: not a creator of the base

404.description: not-found: no such automation or secret

get.summary: Groups of the organization; every member sees them.

post.summary:
Create a group (administrator of the organization). Its name is unique in the organization
whatever the case.

422.description: validation-failed: the name, or another group has it

delete.summary:
Delete a group with its roles (administrator of the organization): its members lose the
access it gave them at once.

patch.summary: Rename a group (administrator of the organization).

422.description: validation-failed: the name, or another group has it

get.summary: Members of a group, by name; every member of the organization sees them.

post.summary:
Add an account to a group (administrator of the organization): it gets the roles of the
group. An administrator adding themselves to a group that holds roles confirms the
password first (`step-up-required`).

204.description: Added, or in the group already

403.description: forbidden: not an administrator; step-up-required: confirm the password

422.description: validation-failed: no such member

delete.summary:
Take an account out of a group (administrator of the organization): it loses the roles
of the group.

404.description: not-found: the group, or the account is not in it

field.description: `fld_…` of the field of attachments the file is for: required for an attachment.

record.description: `rec_…` of the record whose cell the file is for, when the record exists already.

Operation.description: A structure operation carried out in the background.

object.description: Public id of the created object, once it succeeded.

error.description: Code of the error of a failed operation, e.g. `forbidden`.

OptionsInput.description:
Settings of a field: `precision` of a number, an amount or a percent (0–8), `currency`
of an amount, `duration_format` of a duration, `max` of a rating, `choices` of a single
or multiple select — the whole list in its order; a choice left out is removed.

precision.description: Decimal places of a number, an amount or a percent.

currency.description:
ISO 4217 code of the currency of an amount: `RUB` (default), `USD`, `EUR`, `CNY`,
`KZT`, `BYN`, `UZS`, `AMD`, `KGS`, `AZN`, `GEL`, `TRY`, `AED`, `INR`, `GBP`, `JPY`.

choices.description: Choices of a single or multiple select.

table.description:
The table of the same base a link links to (`tbl_…`); given when the field is
added, not changed after.

single.description: A link to one record at most (many by default).

formula.description:
The text of the formula of a formula field, e.g. `{Price} * {Quantity}`; checked
against the fields of the table. Of a rollup — its expression over `values`, the
values of the linked records: `SUM(values)`.

link_field.description:
The link field of the same table a lookup, a count or a rollup reads through
(`fld_…`); given when the field is added, not changed after.

lookup_field.description:
The field of the linked table a lookup shows or a rollup sums up (`fld_…`): a rollup
takes numbers and texts; given when the field is added, not changed after.

condition.description:
The linked records a rollup sums up: a filter over the fields of the linked table, as
the filter of a view; none — all of them. Given when the field is added.

oneOf.description: What a new record gets in the field when it is not given; `null` removes it.
Which values the field takes, whole: it replaces the one before; `null` removes it.

precision.description: Decimal places of a number, an amount or a percent.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code of the currency of an amount.

choices.description: Choices of a single or multiple select.

table.description: The table a link links to (`tbl_…`).

inverse_field.description:
The inverse field of a link in the linked table (`fld_…`); none for a link of a table
with itself.

single.description: A link to one record at most.

formula.description:
The text of the formula of a formula field, its references by the current names of
their fields: a formula reads a field whatever its name.

oneOf.description:
The type of the values of a formula field or a rollup: `number`, `text`, `flag`,
`date`, `date_time` or `texts` (a list of texts); of a lookup — of each of its values.

link_field.description: The link field a lookup, a count or a rollup reads through (`fld_…`).

lookup_field.description: The field of the linked table a lookup shows or a rollup sums up (`fld_…`).

condition.description: The linked records a rollup sums up, as the filter of a view; none — all of them.

oneOf.description: What a new record gets in the field when it is not given.
Which values the field takes beyond its type.

The type of the field is changing: it takes no values until the change is done, and
the table is read again then.

timezone.description: The time zone of dates of formulas, `TODAY` and `NOW`: `Europe/Moscow`.

oneOf.description: The recount of formulas after a new time zone or language, while it goes on.

OrgSettingsChange.description:
A change of the settings of the organization (`PATCH /org/settings`): what is absent
stays.

name.description: A new name, up to 200 characters.

timezone.description: A new time zone of the IANA database. Needs the password confirmed a moment before.

locale.description: A new language: `ru-RU` or `en-US`. Needs the password confirmed a moment before.

OutgoingPolicyBody.description:
Where HTTP actions, webhooks and letters of automations may go. By default nowhere
outside: no host, letters to members only.

any_host.description:
Any host for HTTP actions and webhooks. Turning it on needs the password confirmed
a moment before.

hosts.description:
Hosts of HTTP actions and webhooks: `api.example.com`, `*.example.com` (its
subdomains) or an address; up to 200.

emails.description: Addresses of letters besides the members and the domains of invitations; up to 200.

OwnProvider.description: A provider of the organization and whether one's own account is bound to it.

linked.description: The account logs in through it.

OwnSession.description: A session of one's own account (`GET /me/sessions`).

browser.description:
The browser, by the `User-Agent` of the login: `Chrome`, `Edge`, `Firefox`, `Safari`,
`Opera`, `Yandex Browser`; absent — unknown.

last_seen_at.description: When it was last active, RFC 3339, to five minutes.

OwnerTransfer.description:
A new owner of a workspace or a base whose owner left (`POST /org/access/owner`); the
password is confirmed a moment before.

user.description: `usr_…` of an active person of the organization.

data.description: Records in the order of the view.

next_cursor.description: Give it as `cursor` for the next page; absent on the last one.

PageSpec.description:
A page: rows of cells on a grid of 12 columns — 3 on a window of middle width, 1 on a
narrow one — each cell showing one of its elements.

id.description: Its number, unique in the interface, 1 to 65535.

layout.description: The layout it was made from.

rows.description: The rows of the grid, top to bottom.

elements.description: Its elements; each one stands in exactly one cell.

Passkey.description: A passkey of one's own account.

last_used_at.description: When it last logged in, RFC 3339; absent — never.

PasskeyLogin.description:
The answer of the browser to a ceremony of a passkey: a login (`POST /auth/passkeys/login`)
or a confirmation of the person (`POST /auth/step-up/passkey`).

credential.description: The credential the browser returned, as its `toJSON()` gives it.

PasskeyOptions.description:
The options of a passkey ceremony (`POST /auth/passkeys/options`,
`POST /me/passkeys/registration/options`): what the browser is asked, and the token that
finishes the ceremony within five minutes, once.

options.description:
The options of WebAuthn as JSON (`{"publicKey": …}`, binary values in base64url): its
`publicKey` goes to `PublicKeyCredential.parseCreationOptionsFromJSON` or
`parseRequestOptionsFromJSON` of the browser.

PasswordChange.description: A change of one's own password (`POST /me/password`): the current one confirms it.

PasswordPolicyBody.description:
Passwords and the lockout after failed logins. By default the NIST rules: length only,
no expiry, no history, no lockout.

classes.description:
Classes of characters asked for, 0 to 4: lower case letters, upper case letters,
digits, other signs.

max_age_days.description:
Days a password works before it must be changed at the next login; 0 — no limit;
up to 3650.

history.description: The last passwords of an account a new one must differ from; 0 — none; up to 24.

lockout_attempts.description:
Failed logins by the password after which the account locks; 0 — no lockout; 3 to
100. A login by a passkey is not locked.

lockout_minutes.description: Minutes the lock lasts; 0 — until an administrator unlocks it; up to 43200.

PermissionRow.description: A row: an action checked by role, or a right that comes from elsewhere.

action.description: Stable name of the action (`record.write`); absent for rights from elsewhere.

min_role.description: The lowest role that may do it.

scope.description: `workspace` or `base`: where the role is taken from.

by.description: What the right depends on, for rights from elsewhere.

Permissions.description: The matrix «role × action» of the installed version.

roles.description: Roles from the lowest to the highest; each includes the rights of the previous one.

sections.description: Sections of the matrix in the order of the documentation.

notes.description: Footnotes; `notes` of the actions refer to them by number from 1.

PreconditionFailed.description: The answer `412 precondition-failed` of a write with `if`: nothing was applied.

errors.description: The fields whose values differ, by record.

current.description: The records of `errors` as they are now.

record.description:
`rec_…` chosen in the element the button acts on; required when it names one, absent
otherwise.

fields.description:
For a button that creates a record on a page with an element «fields» of its table:
the values the person filled in, by `fld_…` or name — only the fields of that element.

record.description: `rec_…`: the record created, changed, or the one the automation runs on.

url.description: The address to open in a new tab, its inserts filled.

Problem.description: Body of an error response: RFC 9457 problem details with the problem types of the API.

ProviderCheck.description: What the check of a provider found: its discovery document read and its keys.

ok.description: The provider answers as an OpenID provider of its issuer.

ProviderRef.description: A provider on the login page.

PublicAnswers.description: The answers of a public form with the answer of its task.

fields.description: Values of the questions by `fld_…`, as in a new record.

task.description: The task given for this sending.

website.description: A field no person sees: whatever fills it is taken for a robot.

PublicForm.description: A form as its public link shows it to anyone.

PublicLink.description: The public link of a form view: anyone with it sends the form.

active.description: The view has a working link.

token.description:
The token of the link, only in the answer that made it: the link is `#/f/<token>` of
the address of the service. It is not kept and is not shown again.

created_at.description: When the link was made, RFC 3339.

created_by.description: Who made it, `usr_…`: the link acts with their rights.

forbidden.description: The policy of the organization forbids public links: this one does not open now.

PublicLinksPolicyBody.description: Public links of forms: whether they work in the organization.

allowed.description:
Links work (by default). Forbidden, no new link is made and the links made do not
open; they stay and work again once allowed, which needs the password confirmed a
moment before.

PublicQuestion.description:
A question of a public form: its field — type and settings, no description — and how
it is asked.

label.description: The wording: of the question, or the name of the field.

required.description: An answer is needed while the question is shown.

oneOf.description: Shown only while an earlier answer meets this.

message.description: What the person reads now: the message of the form, or a standard thanks.

PublicUpload.description:
A file for a question of a public form, asked with the answer of the task of the sending:
the bytes follow by `PUT /public/forms/{token}/uploads/{upload}`.

size.description: Its size in bytes, up to 10 MB.

task.description: The task given for this sending.

required.description: An answer is needed while the question is shown.

label.description: The wording instead of the name of the field, up to 500 characters.

help.description: A hint under the question, up to 500 characters.

oneOf.description: Shown only while an earlier answer meets this.

fields.description: Fields of the record that started the run, `fld_…` or names: e-mail, a user, users.

addresses.description: Addresses separated by commas, a template: `a@example.ru, {{ {Менеджер} }}`.

fields.description: Values of the fields; an empty one is `null`.

color.description: Its colour by the colour of the view; absent — none.

more.description:
Links beyond those a cell of a link field carries, by the key of the field: how many
more there are; absent — the cells carry them all.

RecordCount.description:
A count of records (`POST /tables/{table}/records/count`): the filter joined with the
filter of the view by «and»; without a view — the filter alone.

oneOf.description: The filter, as in a query of records.

search.description:
A search: records whose shown text, long text, choice or primary field holds it,
regardless of case and of `ё`; up to 200 characters.

RecordGroups.description:
Groups of records and their summaries (`POST /tables/{table}/records/groups`):
the filter joined with the filter of the view by «and»; groups and summaries instead of
the view's when given. Without groups — the summary row of the whole view.

view.description: `viw_…` of the table: its filter, groups and summaries.

oneOf.description: The filter, as in a query of records.

groups.description: Groups instead of the view's, up to three levels.

search.description:
A search: records whose shown text, long text, choice or primary field holds it,
regardless of case and of `ё`; up to 200 characters.

RecordQuery.description:
A query of records (`POST /tables/{table}/records/query`): `GET …/records` with a filter
in the body, joined by «and» with the filter of the view.

view.description: `viw_…` of the table: its filter and sort.

fields.description: `fld_…` or names of the fields to return; all by default.

oneOf.description: The filter, up to 100 conditions and three levels of groups.

sort.description: The sort instead of the view's, up to five keys.

position.description: Number of a record in the order, from 0: the page starts at it instead of a cursor.

groups.description:
Groups instead of the view's, up to three levels (a temporary grouping). Records of
a grouped view come in the order of the headers of its groups, then of the sort.

group.description:
The records of one group: its values, one per level of the groups, from the first;
`null` — the group of empty values.

oneOf.description: The colour instead of the view's (a temporary colour).

search.description:
A search: records whose shown text, long text, choice or primary field holds it,
regardless of case and of `ё`; up to 200 characters.

records.description: In the order of the request.

fields.description: The fields shown, in order, and which of them may be changed.

actions.description: What may be done with the records; nothing by default.

filtered_by.description: Numbers of the filters of the page that narrow it.

RecountProgress.description: How far the recount of formulas after a new time zone or language has gone.

RecoveryCodes.description: Recovery codes, shown once: each lets one login in without the app.

RejectedValue.description: A value of the file that did not fit its field: its cell stays empty.

row.description: The row of the file, from 1, the row of headers counted.

ResetBody.description: Set a new password by a reset link.

token.description: Token from the fragment of the reset link.

RowHeight.description: Height of the rows of a grid.

cells.description: Its cells left to right; their widths add up to at most 12.

version.description: The version of its definition the run follows.

error.description: Why it failed, was cancelled or skipped.

depth.description: 1 for a change by a person; one more for a change made by another run.

steps.description: Its steps done or failed, in order.

confirm.description: Write even though more than a tenth of the values checked do not fit.

number.description: Its number in the definition, from 1.

SealedPage.description:
The sealed events after a number of seal, oldest first: for a SIEM that takes the events
itself.

events.description: The events, by their number of seal.

after.description:
The number to ask after next time: the last one here, or the one asked for when the
page is empty.

SecondFactorBody.description:
The second factor of a waiting login (`POST /auth/login/second-factor`): a code of the
authenticator app or a recovery code.

pending.description: The token of the waiting login.

code.description: A code of six digits of the authenticator app.

recovery_code.description: One of the recovery codes, used once.

SecondFactorPolicyBody.description:
The second factor of administrators. Without the factor it asks for, the account of an
administrator keeps the flag but not its rights, until the profile has the factor.

admins.description:
Administrators need a second factor: an authenticator app or a passkey. On by default;
turning it off needs the password confirmed a moment before.

admins_passkey_only.description: Only a passkey counts as the second factor of administrators.

everyone.description:
Every person needs a second factor (an authenticator app or a passkey): until the
profile has one, a session reaches only the profile and tokens do not work. Off when
absent; turning it off needs the password confirmed a moment before.

SecretInput.description: The value of a secret to set or replace.

value.description: The value: a key of an external service, a password. Up to 8 KB.

Security.description: The protection of one's own account (`GET /me/security`).

totp.description: The second factor by an authenticator app is on.

new_device_letters.description: A letter comes after a login from a device not seen for 90 days.

details.description: What else is known, without secrets.

SelfGrant.description:
A role an administrator gives themselves in a workspace or a base (`POST /org/access/self`),
to see its data; the password is confirmed a moment before and the owners get a letter.

ServiceAccount.description: An account of an integration: no password, no sessions, it acts by its tokens only.

id.description: `usr_…`: it gets roles in workspaces and bases as a person does.

oneOf.description: The group whose members issue its tokens; absent — the administrators only.

tokens.description: How many of its tokens work.

last_used_at.description: When one of its tokens was used last, RFC 3339.

ServiceAccountPatch.description: A change of a service account; what is absent stays.

group.description: A new responsible group, `grp_…`; an empty text — none.

status.description: `active` or `blocked`: a blocked account's tokens stop working.

SettingChange.description: A new value of a setting.

value.description: A number or a text; `null` — back to the file or the code.

ShownInput.description: When a question is shown: an earlier question and what its answer is.

value.description:
`opt_…` or the name of a choice, `true` or `false` for a checkbox, a text; none for
`is_empty` and `is_not_empty`.

ShownOp.description: How the answer of a condition is compared.

SiemSink.description: A receiver of SIEM: syslog over TLS (RFC 5424, RFC 5425).

sent_at.description: When the last events were delivered, RFC 3339.

last_error.description: Why the last attempt failed; absent once a delivery succeeds.

SiemSinkBody.description: A new receiver of SIEM, or a change of one: what is absent in a change stays.

host.description: The host: a name or an address.

SortInput.description: A key of a sort as the API carries it.

field.description: `fld_…` or the name of the field.

SourceSpec.description: Where the records of an element come from.

view.description: `viw_…` of the table whose filter and sort the element takes.

oneOf.description: The filter every request of the element meets; its users neither see nor lift it.

SsoGroup.description: A group of the organization with the group of the providers it follows.

idp_group.description: The group of the providers; absent — its members are set by hand only.

SsoGroupBody.description: The group of the providers a group follows.

idp_group.description: The name of the group in the claim, up to 200 characters; `null` — none.

SsoPolicyBody.description: The lifetime of the sessions opened through a provider.

session_hours.description:
Hours, 1 to 24; then the browser logs in again through the provider, silently while
the person is logged in there.

oneOf.description: Change the record that started the run.

values.description: The fields and their new values; at least one.

oneOf.description: Create a record in a table of the base.

values.description: The fields of that table and their values.

oneOf.description:
Send a letter of plain text. It goes to members of the organization, to the domains
of invitations and to the addresses the policy «Outgoing addresses» lists; at most 50
recipients.

to.description: Who gets it; at least one field or address.

outside_from_form.description:
A run started by a public form may write outside the organization, where the policy
allows; without it such a run writes to members only.

oneOf.description:
Send an HTTP request to a host the policy «Outgoing addresses» allows. A 2xx answer
is success; the run sends `Idempotency-Key` and, with a signing secret,
`X-Xtab-Signature: t=<time>,v1=<HMAC-SHA256 of "<time>.<body>">`.

url.description:
The address, a template whose scheme and host come before any insert:
`https://api.example.com/orders/{{ {Номер} }}`.

headers.description: Headers; at most 25, none of the protocol.

body.description: The body, a template of JSON: inserts are escaped as its strings.

signing_secret.description: The name of the secret that signs the request.

oneOf.description: Basic authentication.

StepUpBody.description:
Confirm the person again before a sensitive action: the password
of the account of the session.

SummaryInput.description: A summary of a field as the API carries it.

field.description: `fld_…` or the name of the field.

function.description:
`empty`, `filled`, `unique`, `percent_empty`, `percent_filled`; for numbers also
`sum`, `average`, `min`, `max`; for dates `earliest`, `latest`, `range`; for a flag
only `checked` and `unchecked`.

Table.description: A table with its fields and shared views.

manage_views.description:
Whether the one who asks may change its shared views (creator of the base); others
filter and sort for themselves only.

TableInput.description: A new table; without `fields` it gets the primary field «Название».

name.description: Name, unique in the base regardless of case.

fields.description: Its fields; the first one is primary.

TablePatch.description: Changes of a table; what is absent stays.

primary_field.description:
The field that names the records from now on, `fld_…`: a field of the table of a type
that may name them — a text, a number, a date, a choice, an autonumber, a formula.

Token.description: A token, without its value: that is shown once, when it is issued.

hint.description: The last four characters of its value, to tell it apart.

bases.description: Its bases, `bas_…`; absent — every base of its owner.

addresses.description: Addresses or networks it is accepted from; empty — any.

expires_at.description: When it stops working, RFC 3339; absent — never.

last_used_at.description: When it was used last, RFC 3339; absent — never.

name.description: What the token is for, 1 to 200 characters.

bases.description: The bases it works in, `bas_…`; absent — every base of its owner.

expires_in_days.description:
Days until it stops working; absent — never, where the policy of the organization
allows it.

addresses.description: Addresses or networks (CIDR) it is accepted from; empty — any.

TokenPolicyBody.description: The policy of the organization on tokens.

max_days.description: The longest life of a token, in days, 1 to 3650.

sensitive_service_only.description:
Sensitive permissions (`access.grants:write`, `automations:write`,
`data.records:export`) only on tokens of service accounts.

service_addresses_required.description: Tokens of service accounts are limited to addresses.

TotpCode.description: A code of the authenticator app (`POST /me/totp/confirm`).

TotpSetup.description:
A new secret of an authenticator app (`POST /me/totp`): it works once a first code
confirms it.

secret.description: The secret in base32, to type into the app.

uri.description: The `otpauth://` address of the secret, for a QR code.

oneOf.description: A record is created.
One of the fields changed in a record, computed ones included.

fields.description: The fields, `fld_…` or names; at least one.

oneOf.description:
A record began to meet the condition: once, when it passes from not meeting it to
meeting it.
A form of the table sent a record.

A button of an interface that names the automation was pressed on a record of the
table.

TriggerInput.description: What starts a run, always on a record of the table of the automation.

TypeChange.description:
A change of the type of a field: the new type and its settings. Values that do not fit
the new type become empty — `POST /fields/{field}/type-preview` tells how many first.

type.description: The new type, as when a field is added.

options.description: Its settings; choices of a select are made from the values when none are given.

TypePreview.description: What a change of type would do to the values of a field.

loss.description: `none` — every value converts; `possible` — some may become empty.

records.description: Records read for the preview: at most 100 000, the first by their order of creation.

unfit.description: Of them, values that would become empty.

more.description: Whether the table has more records than were read.

examples.description: Up to 10 values that would become empty, as the field shows them now.

keep_changed.description: Keep the records changed since the import; `true` by default.

UploadPurpose.description: What a file is uploaded for.

content_type.description: Its type by its first bytes: for an import `text/csv` or the type of XLSX.

width.description: Pixels across of an image, as it is shown.

height.description: Pixels down of an image, as it is shown.

status.description:
`invited`, `active`, `blocked`, `deactivated` or `anonymized` (deleted on request: no
e-mail, named by the number among the deleted).

second_factor.description:
The account has a second factor: an authenticator app or a passkey. Only for an
administrator who asked for the details.

locked.description:
The login by the password is locked by failed logins. Only for an administrator who
asked for the details.

last_seen_at.description:
When a session of the account was last active, RFC 3339. Only for an administrator who
asked for the details.

external.description:
An external member: a contractor who sees only the people of their workspaces and
bases, makes no workspaces and invites nobody.

UserChange.description:
A change of an account by an administrator (`PATCH /org/users/{user}`): what is absent
stays.

status.description:
`active` or `blocked`. A blocked person cannot log in; their sessions end and their
tokens stop.

is_org_admin.description:
The flag of an administrator of the organization. Giving it needs the password
confirmed a moment before.

external.description:
An external member: a contractor who sees only the people of their workspaces and
bases, makes no workspaces and invites nobody.

next.description: Give it as `after` for the next page; absent on the last one.

ValueSpec.description: A value a button sets: an expression of the language of formulas over the chosen record.

ViewColumn.description: A column of a view: its field, its width and whether it is hidden.

width.description: Width in CSS pixels, 60…600; without it — 180.

hidden.description: Hidden in this view; the primary field never is.

ViewConfig.description:
The settings of a grid view: the order, widths and visibility
of its columns, the height of its rows, its filter, its sort, its groups, the summaries of
its fields and the colour of its records.

columns.description: Columns in their order; fields not listed follow in the order of the table.

oneOf.description: Which records the view shows.

sorts.description: The order of the records, up to five keys; none — the manual order.

groups.description: Groups of the records, up to three levels; within a group the sort applies.

summaries.description: Summaries of fields under their columns and in the headers of groups.

oneOf.description: The colour of the records.

stack.description:
The field whose values are the stacks of a kanban (`fld_…`): a single select or a
user.

cover.description: The field of attachments whose first image covers the cards of a kanban (`fld_…`).

oneOf.description: The questions of a form and what it says.

from.description: A view of the same table (`viw_…`) whose settings the new one copies: «duplicate».

ViewPatch.description: A change of a view: its name, its settings, or both.

oneOf.description: New settings, whole: they replace the old ones.

Workspace.description: A workspace with the bases the user may open.

bases.description: Its bases visible to the user, by name.

role.description:
The role of the user in the workspace itself: `reader`, `commenter`, `editor`,
`creator` or `owner`; absent when only some of its bases are shared with them.

session.name: __Host-xtab_session
session.description: Session of the browser; changing requests also carry `X-Xtab-Request: 1`

token.description: API token `xtab_…` of a person or a service account, issued in the interface. A token acts with the rights of its owner, narrowed by its permissions, bases and addresses; a missing permission answers `403 insufficient-scope`. Requests are limited in rate: `429 rate-limited` with `Retry-After`, the headers `RateLimit-Policy` and `RateLimit`.
